orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: How to use the re.DEBUG flag for debugging regular expressions in Python
orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• In Python, the `re` module helps you search for text patterns using regular expressions.

• To debug a regular expression, you can pass the flag `re.DEBUG` into `re.compile()` or matching functions.

• This `re.DEBUG` flag prints out step-by-step details showing how Python interprets and parses your pattern.
